correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 2^20 subset enumeration agrees with independent face generator: 62048 nonempty faces. Explicit augmented vertex matching has 31004 pairs and 41 critical 7-faces; a topological sort of all 62049 oriented Hasse vertices proves global acyclicity. Unmatching empty-face pair gives one critical vertex and 41 critical 7-cells; discrete Morse proves the integral homotopy wedge. All 240 S5×C2 automorphisms preserve graph edges; exact signed chain Lefschetz traces on 14 conjugacy classes, verified S5 irreducible-character orthogonality, and integer inner products yield exactly nine constituents. Full-quotient rational homology is the invariant module. Verification source included and reproducible; independent audit not performed.

value.rationale: The cubic Desargues graph is a canonical symmetric Levi graph. Parameter two is the first higher-independence case and turns the full graph into a natural nonchordal test object. An integral 41-sphere homotopy decomposition with an exact full automorphism representation (central 21/20 splitting, nine irreducibles, a quotient-invariant line) is structurally stronger than a Betti number; it supplies a motivated benchmark for topological and equivariant study of higher independence complexes of symmetric graphs. It is neither a renaming of Ind_1 nor a routine substitution into known families.
